entities.name: Zof
entities.description: A foreboding mangrove swamp on the northwest coast of Guul Draz on Zendikar.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: A small clan of Tajuru elves survives in the marsh.

entities.name: Voshk
entities.description: An oblivion priest who draws nihilistic inspiration from Zof.

entities.name: Helix of Zof
entities.description: An ancient spiral ruin deep in the swamp, a post-Eldrazi ruin of unknown origin.

relations.quote: Zof stretches along the northwest coast of Guul Draz
Deep within the swamp lies the ancient ruin known as the Helix of Zof
